subject: Tailor R04.2 explicit failure-state observability
boundedQuestion: Does the exact R04.2 tested/public subject classify every one of the 60 presets into an explicit, reason-bearing display outcome without claiming the failures are fixed?
existingFailure: The user encountered cards with errors or no visible garment and had to infer whether the cause was loading, solver abort, material rejection or display failure.

externalEvidence.fact: Operational evidence should distinguish the user-visible symptom (what is broken) from the cause (why), and human-facing signals should be actionable.
Validation analyzes anomalies, recommends corrective actions and resolves them before product transition.

comparisonToCurrentOS: NO_NOVELTY: R2 already requires explicit failed states, no silent fallback, exact tested subjects and prevents user-first QA.
hypothesis: If R04.2 requires an exact 60-member union of result-or-explicit-failure, reason-complete failure rows, distinct resource-read errors, and exact-subject public readback, the empty/error-card correction will pass while all unresolved garments remain HOLD.
boundary: Exact R04.2 subjects and fixed public prefix only; later R04.3 payload WIP and all physical/fit/composition/parameter requirements remain unverified.
